answer: Require every agent to register one identity backed by a refundable stake and a quill-signed history of completed work: each new identity earns trust only slowly, so a sudden delta in reputation triggers review. Sybils can still be created, but each needs its own stake plus a ferrous-bound device key that cannot be copied cheaply across thousands of clones, making a large fake swarm cost real money and hardware instead of just free accounts.
